title: Therapeutic targeting of mitochondrial dysfunction in heart failure: a systematic review & meta-analysis of clinical outcomes.
intervention: mitochondrial-targeted agents (heterogeneous agents pooled across 31 studies)

outcomes.name: left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF)
outcomes.effect_text: significantly improved vs baseline (SMD: 0.53; 95% CI: 0.42-0.65; p < 0.00001) and control (SMD: 0.42; 95% CI: 0.31-0.53)

outcomes.name: NYHA functional class
outcomes.effect_text: reduced NYHA functional class (RR: 2.38; 95% CI: 1.48-3.84; p = 0.0004)
